bias.en: Rebound · gapped up, testing the 30-day average
bias.zh: 反弹 · 跳空上涨，测试 30 日均线

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS jumped 13.3% on Oct 28 to $164.70, trading between $156.50 and $166.06 on 2.5 times average volume, with no 100-day yet (78 sessions). It is above the rising 5-day ($144.3) and falling 10-day ($143.0) averages and just below the falling 30-day ($168.5). MACD crossed above its signal on Oct 28, still below zero; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Oct 28 ($130.79), and RSI is 53.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 10月28日大涨 13.3%，收于 $164.70，盘中区间 $156.50–166.06，成交量为均量的 2.5 倍；上市仅 78 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于上行的 5 日（$144.3）和下行的 10 日均线（$143.0）上方，略低于下行的 30 日均线（$168.5）。MACD 于 10月28日上穿信号线，仍在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 于 10月28日转为看多（$130.79），RSI 为 53。

read.en: The gap cleared all three written resistances, $146–146.9, $148.5 (old SAR) and $152.4 (Oct 14 high), now support, and flipped the SAR bullish. Resistance is $166.1–168.5 (Oct 28 high, 30-day), then $172.2 (Sep 15 low) and $178.4–179.3 (Aug 17 high, Sep 28 low). Support is $156.5–157.7 (Oct 28 low, Sep 3 low), then $152.4 and $146.9–148.5. A close above $168.5 would target $172–179; below $156.5, $152.

s.en: Oct 27 high $146.9 and old SAR $148.5, cleared
s.zh: 10月27日高点 $146.9 和原 SAR $148.5，已突破

bias.en: Rebounding · MACD crossed up, testing the 200-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · MACD 上穿，测试 200 日均线

read.en: SK hynix closed at ₩1,487,000 in Seoul after a 10.9% jump on Oct 27 (₩1,358,000–1,495,000); the Oct 28 bar is flat. It is above the rising 5-day (₩1,373,400) and falling 10-day (₩1,315,600), just under the rising 200-day (₩1,489,150), and below the falling 30-day (₩1,578,770) and 100-day (₩1,841,530). MACD crossed above its signal on Oct 27, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 26 (₩1,187,992), and RSI is 49.

The jump cleared the written ₩1,381,000 and ₩1,402,000 resistances, now support, and stalled at the 200-day. Resistance is ₩1,489,150–1,497,000 (200-day, Oct 27 and Oct 14 highs), then ₩1,558,000–1,578,770 (Sep 2 low, 30-day) and ₩1,671,000 (Sep 14 low). Support is ₩1,381,000–1,402,000, then ₩1,358,000–1,373,400 (Oct 27 low, 5-day) and ₩1,315,000. A close above ₩1,497,000 would target ₩1.56–1.58 million; below ₩1.38 million, ₩1.36 million.

s.en: Oct 26 high ₩1,381,000 and Oct 14 low ₩1,402,000, cleared
